title: Dusun Witu language - Wikipedia
text: Dusun Witu, or Witu, is a language spoken by the Dusun Witu people of Borneo specifically in Kalimantan Tengah Province, South Barito regency, near Pendang and Buntokecil towns; south of Muarateweh town in Indonesia.

title: Dusun Witu | Ethnologue Free
text: Dusun Witu is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by a decreasing number of young people.
